headline: As of 2025-10-23, amoxicillin has 4 fully approved applications, 3 actively marketed, and 1 oral suspension shortage record at Current status, and the application counts cannot be limited to oral suspension.
markdown:
## Answer
As of 2025-10-23, the data show 6 amoxicillin applications. Of these, 4 are fully approved and 3 are actively marketed (Prescription). These counts cover all amoxicillin dosage forms, not oral suspension alone, because the application data has no dosage-form field [E3]. One oral suspension shortage record is at Current status [E3].

## Detail
- Applications, full approval scope: 4 fully approved and 2 Tentative Approval, out of 6 total [E3].
- Applications, include-tentative scope: 6 approved [E4].
- Actively marketed (Prescription) is 3 under both scopes [E3, E4].
- Approved but Discontinued: 1 application, ANDA065491 (Teva Pharmaceuticals USA Inc), marketing status Discontinued [E3].
- Current shortage: DS-2023-0142, Amoxicillin Oral Suspension 250mg/5mL, status Current. It was first posted 2023-08-01 and last revised 2024-01-10. The reason category is Manufacturing Delay, and the related application is ANDA065355 [E3].
- Source row for that shortage: drug_shortages#L2 [E3].
- Status history of that shortage: an earlier revision was recorded as Resolved, and the latest revision is Current. The latest revision governs, and the earlier Resolved record is disclosed, not ignored [E3].
- A second oral suspension record, for a different strength, has latest status Discontinued. Discontinued means the manufacturer has stopped or will stop producing it and supply will not recover from that source. It is not Resolved and not Current [E3].

## Interpretation applied
- "Approved": the reading used is full approval, which excludes Tentative Approval, giving 4. The alternate includes tentative approvals and gives 6 [E3, E4].
- "Currently in shortage": the reading used is latest revision per shortage record with status Current, as of 2025-10-23, giving 1 record. Discontinued is not counted as in shortage [E3].
- "How many drugs": counted at the generic-name level, which is Amoxicillin. The presentation filter is Oral Suspension% [E3].
- Name matching: "amoxicillin" resolved exactly to Amoxicillin. Amoxicillin-Clavulanate is a separate substring match and is not included [E1].

## Caveats
- The application data has no dosage-form column, so the application counts may overstate oral suspension applications [E3].
- The Current shortage was last revised 2024-01-10, more than eighteen months before the as-of date. It is flagged stale and should be confirmed before it is quoted [E3].
- That shortage has conflicting status records, Resolved and then Current [E3].
- Amoxicillin-Clavulanate shortage records link to an application whose active ingredient is Amoxicillin. This is a possible mislink. It affects linkage for those records only and does not change the amoxicillin oral suspension records above [E3].

## Cannot be answered from this data
- The number of approved or marketed applications for oral suspension specifically, because applications carry no dosage form [E3].
- Which applications correspond to which oral suspension strengths [E3].
- Whether the Current shortage is still active today. The data only show its last recorded revision [E3].
